title: A message that says a lane was added or merged checks git first
why: Runner 8 told the coordinator #2268 and #2555 were added to batch 73 when git showed them only queued; a claim in a cross-session message went unchecked.
note: Proposed by runner 8, relayed by coordinator 13:01 CST Nov 10; queued by triage. Guard: before a send_message says a lane was added, merged or released, the sender reads git log of the named branch, or the message guard refuses the claim.
